maintainer_notes: Approved content for the Module A enquiry assistant. Only approved_text and fixed_replies are shown to participants or the model; notes are for maintainers.

Placeholders in braces are filled from the live course catalogue: course_name, course_fee, duration, training_time, intake_list, website, paynow_uen, claim_page, course_list, da_course_fee, fd_course_fee.
Entries with confirmation_required true must never be stated as fact; their approved_text is the only permitted reply.

followup_templates are the approved reminders (one per step, sent at FOLLOWUP_HOURS). They hold no fees or dates and must keep the STOP opt-out; the assistant may personalise them from memory but falls back to them unchanged.

suggestions are the only buttons the assistant can offer. Each covers the entries it leads to; a suggestion is hidden once any covered entry has been answered for the participant (in this or an earlier chat). starter_suggestions open a new chat; suggestion_order fills the buttons when the assistant picks none.
Entries with lists_intakes true show one course's selectable dates; after a reply citing one, a bare date such as '18 November' is treated as interest in that intake.
Reply-template wording is kept, with spelling corrected; dates and venue are omitted because live intakes and decision D1 replace them.

entries.approved_text:
Dental Assisting is a valuable skill set that can be learned and developed with practice. During this 2-day class, you'll be guided through your daily job scope such as:
• recognising dental instruments & materials
• infection control
• how to anticipate the dentist's needs during procedures
With consistent practice and hands-on experience, you'll build confidence and become more proficient in assisting.

entries.topic: Course fee, duration and training hours

entries.approved_text:
Upcoming intakes for the {course_name}:
{intake_list}

There are three modes of payment.
1) SkillsFuture Credit basic tier (please note that our course is not eligible for Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits)
2) PayNow. UEN: {paynow_uen}
3) NTUC Union Membership (UTAP): 50% off the course fee. You'll have to pay upfront first and get reimbursed after completion of the course. You are not able to use both SkillsFuture Credit and the Union member subsidy; you can only use either UTAP or SkillsFuture Credits.

You can check your SkillsFuture Credit balance using this link: {claim_page}
Please let me know how much credit you'll be using to pay for the course. This helps us generate an accurate invoice for your SkillsFuture claim submission, and we'll email you the steps to claim from the SkillsFuture portal.

There are two tiers of SkillsFuture Credit. Our courses are only eligible for the basic tier. You cannot use Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credit to pay for this course fee; Mid-Career credits are usually for longer courses. You may log in to the SkillsFuture portal to find out the balance of your basic-tier SkillsFuture credits: {claim_page}
entries.source: reply_template — Can use Midcareer Skillsfuture?; workflow_deck — slide 3

entries.topic: Topping up when SkillsFuture Credit is not enough
entries.approved_text: If your basic-tier SkillsFuture Credit balance is less than the course fee, you can use your credits for part of the fee and top up the remaining amount (the course fee minus the credits you use) via PayNow.
entries.source: workflow_deck — slide 3 (participant with partial credit told to top up the difference via PayNow)

entries.approved_text: PayNow is accepted. UEN: {paynow_uen}. Payment arrangements are handled after your enrollment is confirmed.

All NTUC Union members are eligible for 50% unfunded course fee support, up to $250 per year (or up to $500 per year for NTUC members aged 40 and above) through the Union Training Assistance Programme (UTAP) for this course.
How to apply for UTAP funding support:
Step 1: Ensure your NTUC Union membership is valid. You can check your membership status by chatting with NTUC's chat bot at ntuc.co/chat or logging in to your U Portal at www.ntuc.org.sg
Step 2: Enroll in the course and attend both days of training.
Step 3: After completing the course, log in to your U Portal account to submit your UTAP claim. You will need proof of payment (e.g. course invoice/receipt) and proof of completion (e.g. certificate/results slip). Both documents will be provided to you after the course.
Important: Please submit your UTAP claim within 6 months of course completion. Late submissions will not be accepted.
entries.source: reply_template — How to Apply for UTAP Funding Support

entries.topic: Concern that the course is expensive
entries.approved_text:
Thank you for your feedback regarding the course fee. We understand that cost is an important consideration, and we strive to ensure that our pricing reflects the value and quality of the education and resources provided.
The fee for our 2-day course includes comprehensive materials, expert instruction, and access to specialised equipment and facilities. We believe this investment will greatly benefit your professional development and skill set.
However, we do appreciate your concerns and will take them into consideration for future planning. If there are specific aspects of the course or pricing you'd like to discuss further, please feel free to reach out :)
entries.source: reply_template — Why is your course so expensive?

entries.approved_text:
We do offer job opportunities for suitable candidates on the last day of the class. The selection process from HR involves various contributing factors to ensure we find the best fit for the role, including:
- location of workplace
- schedule
- skills and experience
- cultural fit
- interview performance
A job is not guaranteed.
entries.source: reply_template — Will I be offered a position at the end of the course?

entries.topic: HR interview for a Dental Assistant position
entries.approved_text: If you're interested in joining Q&M as a Dental Assistant, you'll need to go through the standard HR interview process like all candidates. This includes submitting your resume and attending a Zoom interview with HR. If you pass the interview, you'll then be offered a position, and we'll also have mentors to guide and support you along the way, so you won't be learning alone 😊 We aren't able to advise on the specific questions HR may ask.

We prefer candidates with GCE 'N' Levels. However, if you do not have GCE 'N' Levels, we are open to considering candidates who have basic reading and writing skills in English, as the classes and assessment will be conducted in English. No prior dental experience is needed :)
entries.notes: 'No prior dental experience is needed' follows the deck's description of the course as beginner-friendly (slide 2) and the proposal's FAQ on attending without experience (§2).
entries.source: reply_template — minimum qualification; workflow_deck — slides 2 and 3

entries.approved_text:
To register, we'll need:
1. Full name (as per NRIC)
2. NRIC number
3. Date of birth
4. Email address
5. Mobile number
6. Whether you will be using SkillsFuture credits or PayNow/internet transfer to pay for the course fee
Once we have your details, we'll generate your invoice and email you the confirmation and the steps to claim from the SkillsFuture portal. Just let me know when you'd like to enroll.
The training venue will be confirmed in your enrollment confirmation. If you'd like to know sooner, I can ask our team to confirm it for you.
entries.notes: Sources conflict: reply template says HQ, Clementi Loop; deck slide 2 says Q&M City Square Mall Auditorium. Decision D1: do not state a venue.

fixed_replies.first_contact_privacy: To help you better, I remember what we chat about. Reply "forget me" anytime to clear it, or STOP to stop reminders.
fixed_replies.language_note: Just so you know, I reply in English as our classes and assessments are conducted in English.
fixed_replies.unanswered: I don't have confirmed information about {subject}. I've asked our team to check and get back to you 😊
fixed_replies.human_request: Sure! I've asked a member of our team to get in touch with you here. In the meantime, I'm happy to help with any course questions.
fixed_replies.crisis_support: I'm really sorry you're going through this. If you are in immediate danger, please call 995. You can also talk to someone at Samaritans of Singapore (SOS) any time on 1767; it's free and confidential. I've let a member of our team know so they can reach out to you.
fixed_replies.decline_instructions: I'm not able to share how I work behind the scenes, but I'm happy to help with any questions about our courses 😊
fixed_replies.abuse_close: I'd like to keep our conversation respectful, so I'll pause here and ask a member of our team to follow up with you.
fixed_replies.opt_out: Understood. We won't send you any more reminders. If you have questions later, just message us here.
fixed_replies.forget_me: Done! I've cleared what I remembered from our chats. Any enrollment you've made isn't affected. How else can I help?
fixed_replies.fallback: Sorry, I'm having trouble answering right now. I've asked our team to follow up with you, or you can try again in a moment.
